hypotheses.U1_four_factor_shapley_recomposes_routes: QK1/QK2/current-value/inherited-bus Shapley effects reconstruct every insertion and removal route within 1e-5 relative error.
hypotheses.U2_both_value_paths_are_substantial: At layer 4, current-value and inherited-bus each have at least 20% median absolute downstream Shapley share for the frozen route on both corpora.
hypotheses.U3_value_paths_cancel: At layer 4, the magnitude of current-value plus inherited-bus projection is at most half their summed absolute magnitudes on both corpora.
hypotheses.U4_value_path_mix_transfers_ood: At layer 4, FineWeb and TinyStories frozen-route four-factor absolute shares have L1 distance at most 0.25.
hypotheses.U5_value_path_attribution_is_cross_world: Frozen-route insertion and removal four-factor projections correlate at least 0.70 across records and layers on both corpora.
hypotheses.U6_frozen_and_oracle_value_paths_match: At layer 4, frozen and oracle median removal four-factor vectors have cosine at least 0.80 on both corpora.
hypotheses.U7_qk_remains_secondary: At layer 4, QK1 plus QK2 have at most 20% median absolute downstream Shapley share for the frozen route on both corpora.
